quranTranslation.text: When the night grew dark upon him he beheld a star. He said: This is my Lord. But when it set, he said: I love not things that set.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim je ugledao zvijezdu – viđenje očima.
explanation.en: Abraham saw a star — sight with the eyes.

quranTranslation.text: When Joseph said unto his father: O my father! Lo! I saw in a dream eleven planets and the sun and the moon, I saw them prostrating themselves unto me.

explanation.bs: Jusuf je vidio jedanaest zvijezda u snu – viđenje u snu.
explanation.en: Joseph saw eleven stars in a dream — seeing in a dream.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?

explanation.bs: „Zar nisi vidio…“ o događaju koji Poslanik nije gledao očima: viđenje kao sigurno znanje.
explanation.en: “Hast thou not seen…” of an event the Prophet did not witness with his eyes: seeing as certain knowledge.

quranTranslation.text: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?

explanation.bs: Poziv da se pogled zadrži na devi i razmisli kako je stvorena.
explanation.en: A call to rest the gaze on the camel and reflect on how it was created.

quranTranslation.text: So let man consider from what he is created.

explanation.bs: „Pa neka čovjek pogleda od čega je stvoren“ – gledanje kao razmišljanje.
explanation.en: “So let man consider from what he is created” — looking as reflection.

quranTranslation.text: Couldst thou but see when the guilty hang their heads before their Lord, (and say): Our Lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back; we will do right, now we are sure.

explanation.bs: Na Sudnjem danu grešnici kažu „Gospodaru naš, vidjeli smo“ – istina im je postala jasna.
explanation.en: On the Day the wrongdoers say “Our Lord! We have now seen” — the truth has become clear to them.

quranTranslation.text: And of them is he who looketh toward thee. But canst thou guide the blind even though they see not?

explanation.bs: Gledaju u Poslanika, a nemaju uvida; one koji ne uviđaju, slijepe srcem, puko gledanje ne upućuje.
explanation.en: They look at the Prophet yet have no insight; the blind of heart are not guided by looking alone.

quranTranslation.text: Allah chargeth you concerning (the provision for) your children: to the male the equivalent of the portion of two females, and if there be women more than two, then theirs is two-thirds of the inheritance, and if there be one (only) then the half. And to each of his parents a sixth of the inheritance, if he have a son; and if he have no son and his parents are his heirs, then to his mother appertaineth the third; and if he have brethren, then to his mother appertaineth the sixth, after any legacy he may have bequeathed, or debt (hath been paid). Your parents and your children: Ye know not which of them is nearer unto you in usefulness. It is an injunction from Allah. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „…ako je umrli imao dijete (وَلَد)“ – riječ obuhvata i sinove i kćeri.
explanation.en: The parents' share depends on whether the deceased has a child (وَلَد) — the word covers sons and daughters alike.

quranTranslation.text: And he of Egypt who purchased him said unto his wife: Receive him honourably. Perchance he may prove useful to us or we may adopt him as a son. Thus we established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events. And Allah was predominant in His career, but most of mankind know not.

explanation.bs: „Možda nam bude od koristi, ili ga uzmemo za sina (نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا)“ – posvojče kao وَلَد.
explanation.en: “Perchance he may prove useful to us or we may adopt him as a son (نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا)” — the adopted child as وَلَد.

quranTranslation.text: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.

explanation.bs: „A Milostivom ne priliči da uzme dijete“ – Allah nema potomka.
explanation.en: “…it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son (وَلَد)” — Allah has no offspring.

quranTranslation.text: It is not righteousness that ye turn your faces to the East and the West; but righteous is he who believeth in Allah and the Last Day and the angels and the Scripture and the prophets; and giveth wealth, for love of Him, to kinsfolk and to orphans and the needy and the wayfarer and to those who ask, and to set slaves free; and observeth proper worship and payeth the poor-due. And those who keep their treaty when they make one, and the patient in tribulation and adversity and time of stress. Such are they who are sincere. Such are the Allah-fearing.

explanation.bs: Dobročinstvo je dati imetak i „putniku“ (ابْن السَّبِيل) – ‚sin puta‘, preneseno.
explanation.en: Righteousness is to give wealth also to “the wayfarer” (ابْن السَّبِيل) — the ‘son of the road’, figuratively.

quranTranslation.text: O Children of Adam! We have revealed unto you raiment to conceal your shame, and splendid vesture, but the raiment of restraint from evil, that is best. This is of the revelations of Allah, that they may remember.

explanation.bs: „O sinovi Ademovi!“ (يَا بَنِي آدَمَ) – svi ljudi kao Ademovi potomci.
explanation.en: “O Children of Adam!” (يَا بَنِي آدَمَ) — all people as Adam's descendants.

quranTranslation.text: And Noah cried unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Lo! my son is of my household! Surely Thy promise is the truth and Thou are the Most Just of Judges.

explanation.bs: Nuh: „Gospodaru moj, moj sin je, zaista, iz moje porodice“ – sin po rodu.
explanation.en: Noah: “My Lord! Lo! my son is of my household!” — a son by lineage.

quranTranslation.text: Thus Allah expoundeth unto you His revelations so that ye may understand.

explanation.bs: „Tako vam Allah pojašnjava Svoje ajete da biste razumjeli.“
explanation.en: “Thus Allah expoundeth unto you His revelations so that ye may understand.”

quranTranslation.text: With clear proofs and writings; and We have revealed unto thee the Remembrance that thou mayst explain to mankind that which hath been revealed for them, and that haply they may reflect.

explanation.bs: „…da ljudima pojasniš ono što im je objavljeno“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za بَيَّنَ.
explanation.en: “…that thou mayst explain to mankind that which hath been revealed for them” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for بَيَّنَ.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when Allah laid a charge on those who had received the Scripture (He said): Ye are to expound it to mankind and not to hide it. But they flung it behind their backs and bought thereby a little gain. Verily evil is that which they have gained thereby.

explanation.bs: „Zaista ćete je ljudima pojašnjavati i nećete je skrivati“ – pojasniti je suprotno od skriti.
explanation.en: “Ye are to expound it to mankind and not to hide it” — to make clear is the opposite of to conceal.

quranTranslation.text: Alif. Lam. Ra. (This is) a Scripture the revelations whereof are perfected and then expounded. (It cometh) from One Wise, Informed,

explanation.bs: „Knjiga čiji su ajeti učvršćeni, pa onda potanko izloženi, od Onoga Koji je Mudar i o svemu obaviješten“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “A Scripture the revelations whereof are perfected and then expounded. (It cometh) from One Wise, Informed” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: How should ye not eat of that over which the name of Allah hath been mentioned, when He hath explained unto you that which is forbidden unto you unless ye are compelled thereto. But lo! many are led astray by their own lusts through ignorance. Lo! thy Lord, He is Best Aware of the transgressors.

explanation.bs: „…a On vam je već razložio šta vam je zabranio“ – zabranjeno, potanko izloženo.
explanation.en: “…when He hath explained unto you that which is forbidden unto you” — what is forbidden, set out in detail.

quranTranslation.text: And We appoint the night and the day two portents. Then We make dark the portent of the night, and We make the portent of the day sight-giving, that ye may seek bounty from your Lord, and that ye may know the computation of the years, and the reckoning; and everything have We expounded with a clear expounding.

explanation.bs: „…i svaku smo stvar razložili potanko“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And everything have We expounded with a clear expounding” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! religion with Allah (is) the Surrender (to His Will and Guidance). Those who (formerly) received the Scripture differed only after knowledge came unto them, through transgression among themselves. Whoso disbelieveth the revelations of Allah (will find that) lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.

explanation.bs: „Vjera je kod Allaha, zaista, islam“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Lo! religion with Allah (is) the Surrender” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Who is better in religion than he who surrendereth his purpose to Allah while doing good (to men) and followeth the tradition of Abraham, the upright? Allah (Himself) chose Abraham for friend.

explanation.bs: „A čija je vjera bolja od vjere onoga koji svoje lice preda Allahu…“ – ar-Rāġib: vjera ovdje znači pokornost.
explanation.en: “Who is better in religion than he who surrendereth his purpose to Allah…” — ar-Rāġib: religion here means obedience.

quranTranslation.text: Master of the Day of Judgment,

explanation.bs: „Vladaru Sudnjeg dana (يَوْمِ الدِّينِ)“ – dīn u značenju obračuna.
explanation.en: “Master of the Day of Judgment (يَوْمِ الدِّينِ)” — dīn in the sense of requital.

quranTranslation.text: And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob. It never was for us to attribute aught as partner to Allah. This is of the bounty of Allah unto us (the seed of Abraham) and unto mankind; but most men give not thanks.

explanation.bs: Jusuf: „I slijedim vjerski put svojih očeva, Ibrahima, Ishaka i Jakuba“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Joseph: “And I have followed the religion [milla] of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Allah speaketh truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, the upright. He was not of the idolaters.

explanation.bs: „Reci: Allah je istinu rekao, pa slijedite vjerski put Ibrahima, pravovjernika.“
explanation.en: “Say: Allah speaketh truth. So follow the religion [milla] of Abraham, the upright.”

quranTranslation.text: And those who disbelieved said unto their messengers: Verily we will drive you out from our land, unless ye return to our religion. Then their Lord inspired them, (saying): Verily we shall destroy the wrong-doers,

explanation.bs: Nevjernici poslanicima: „… ili ćete se vratiti našem vjerskom putu“ – milla zajednice, ne poslanika.
explanation.en: The disbelievers to their messengers: “… unless ye return to our religion [milla]” — the creed of a community, not of a prophet.

quranTranslation.text: And unto thee have We revealed the Scripture with the truth, confirming whatever Scripture was before it, and a watcher over it. So judge between them by that which Allah hath revealed, and follow not their desires away from the truth which hath come unto thee. For each We have appointed a divine law and a traced-out way. Had Allah willed He could have made you one community. But that He may try you by that which He hath given you (He hath made you as ye are). So vie one with another in good works. Unto Allah ye will all return, and He will then inform you of that wherein ye differ.

explanation.bs: „Svakome od vas odredili smo zakon i jasan put“ – jedini spomen ove riječi; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “For each We have appointed a divine law and a traced-out way” — the only place of this word; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Allah je od vode stvorio svako živo biće: neka se od njih kreću na trbuhu, neka na dvije noge, a neka na četiri“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And there is not a beast in the earth but the sustenance thereof dependeth on Allah. He knoweth its habitation and its repository. All is in a clear Record.

explanation.bs: „Nema nijednog živog bića na Zemlji, a da njegova opskrba nije na Allahu“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And there is not a beast in the earth but the sustenance thereof dependeth on Allah” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: There is not an animal in the earth, nor a flying creature flying on two wings, but they are peoples like unto you. We have neglected nothing in the Book (of Our decrees). Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.

explanation.bs: „Nema živog bića na Zemlji, niti ptice što na dva krila leti, a da nisu zajednice kao i vi“ – ptica se navodi pored dābbe; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “There is not an animal in the earth, nor a flying creature flying on two wings, but they are peoples like unto you” — the bird is named beside the dābba; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat;

explanation.bs: „I stoku je On stvorio za vas; u njoj imate toplinu i koristi, i od nje jedete.“
explanation.en: “And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat.”

quranTranslation.text: Allah it is Who hath appointed for you cattle, that ye may ride on some of them, and eat of some -

explanation.bs: „Allah je Onaj Koji je za vas učinio stoku – da na nekima od nje jašete, a nekima se hranite.“
explanation.en: “Allah it is Who hath appointed for you cattle, that ye may ride on some of them, and eat of some.”

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Fulfil your indentures. The beast of cattle is made lawful unto you (for food) except that which is announced unto you (herein), game being unlawful when ye are on the pilgrimage. Lo! Allah ordaineth that which pleaseth Him.

explanation.bs: „Dopušteno vam je živinče od stoke, izuzev onoga što vam se kazuje“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “The beast of cattle is made lawful unto you (for food) except that which is announced unto you” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And for every nation have We appointed a ritual, that they may mention the name of Allah over the beast of cattle that He hath given them for food; and your god is One God, therefor surrender unto Him. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the humble,

explanation.bs: „Svakoj zajednici dali smo obred, kako bi spominjali Allahovo ime nad živinčetom od stoke koje im je On dao za opskrbu.“
explanation.en: “And for every nation have We appointed a ritual, that they may mention the name of Allah over the beast of cattle that He hath given them for food.”

quranTranslation.text: Between them is a veil. And on the Heights are men who know them all by their marks. And they call unto the dwellers of the Garden: Peace be unto you! They enter it not although they hope (to enter).

explanation.bs: „Između njih je zastor …“ – ar-Rāġib: pregrada koja sprečava da stanje jednih dopre do drugih.
explanation.en: “Between them is a veil.” — ar-Rāġib: a barrier that keeps the state of each from reaching the other.

quranTranslation.text: And it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil, or (that) He sendeth a messenger to reveal what He will by His leave. Lo! He is Exalted, Wise.

explanation.bs: „Nijednom čovjeku nije dato da mu Allah govori osim objavom, ili iza zastora …“ – ar-Rāġib: tako da Ga onaj kome se obraća ne vidi.
explanation.en: “it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil” — ar-Rāġib: so that the one spoken to does not see Him.

quranTranslation.text: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.

explanation.bs: „Bio si u nemaru prema ovome, a sada smo s tebe odmakli tvoj pokrivač, pa ti je pogled danas prodoran.“ – pokrivač neznanja je skinut; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering [ġiṭāʾ], and piercing is thy sight this day.” — the cover of ignorance is lifted; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Those whose eyes were hoodwinked from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear.

explanation.bs: „one čije su oči bile pod pokrivačem od sjećanja na Mene …“ – pokrivač preko očiju.
explanation.en: “Those whose eyes were hoodwinked [in a cover, ġiṭāʾ] from My reminder” — a cover over the eyes.

quranTranslation.text: And they say: Our hearts are protected from that unto which thou (O Muhammad) callest us, and in our ears there is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil. Act, then. Lo! we also shall be acting.

explanation.bs: „I govore: ‚Naša srca su u omotačima od onoga čemu nas pozivaš, u ušima nam je gluhoća, a između nas i tebe je zastor …‘“ – riječi poricatelja: omotači na srcima i zastor između njih u jednom ajetu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Our hearts are protected [in sheaths, akinna] from that unto which thou (O Muhammad) callest us, and in our ears there is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil.” — the deniers' words: sheaths on the hearts and a veil between them in one ayah; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Of them are some who listen unto thee, but We have placed upon their hearts veils, lest they should understand, and in their ears a deafness. If they saw every token they would not believe therein; to the point that, when they come unto thee to argue with thee, the disbelievers say: This is naught else than fables of the men of old.

explanation.bs: „… a Mi smo na njihova srca stavili omotače da ga ne bi razumjeli …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “We have placed upon their hearts veils [akinna], lest they should understand” — ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom.

explanation.bs: „Allah je stavio pečat na njihova srca i na njihov sluh, a preko njihovih očiju je koprena …“ – o onima opisanim u 2:6; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering [ġišāwa].” — of those described in 2:6; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! When ye contract a debt for a fixed term, record it in writing. Let a scribe record it in writing between you in (terms of) equity. No scribe should refuse to write as Allah hath taught him, so let him write, and let him who incurreth the debt dictate, and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord, and diminish naught thereof. But if he who oweth the debt is of low understanding, or weak, or unable himself to dictate, then let the guardian of his interests dictate in (terms of) equity. And call to witness, from among your men, two witnesses. And if two men be not (at hand) then a man and two women, of such as ye approve as witnesses, so that if the one erreth (through forgetfulness) the other will remember. And the witnesses must not refuse when they are summoned. Be not averse to writing down (the contract) whether it be small or great, with (record of) the term thereof. That is more equitable in the sight of Allah and more sure for testimony, and the best way of avoiding doubt between you; save only in the case when it is actual merchandise which ye transfer among yourselves from hand to hand. In that case it is no sin for you if ye write it not. And have witnesses when ye sell one to another, and let no harm be done to scribe or witness. If ye do (harm to them) lo! it is a sin in you. Observe your duty to Allah. Allah is teaching you. And Allah is knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „Vi koji vjerujete, kad međusobno pravite dug s utvrđenim rokom, zapišite ga …“ – dug među ljudima, uz pisara i svjedoke; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! When ye contract a debt for a fixed term, record it in writing” — a debt among people, with a scribe and witnesses; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Allah chargeth you concerning (the provision for) your children: to the male the equivalent of the portion of two females, and if there be women more than two, then theirs is two-thirds of the inheritance, and if there be one (only) then the half. And to each of his parents a sixth of the inheritance, if he have a son; and if he have no son and his parents are his heirs, then to his mother appertaineth the third; and if he have brethren, then to his mother appertaineth the sixth, after any legacy he may have bequeathed, or debt (hath been paid). Your parents and your children: Ye know not which of them is nearer unto you in usefulness. It is an injunction from Allah. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „… nakon oporuke koju je ostavio ili duga …“ – dug se namiruje iz ostavštine prije nego što se podijele dijelovi; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “… after any legacy he may have bequeathed, or debt (hath been paid)” — the debt is settled from the estate before the shares are given; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: Who is it that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, so that He may give it increase manifold? Allah straiteneth and enlargeth. Unto Him ye will return.

explanation.bs: „Ko će to Allahu pozajmiti lijepim zajmom, a On će mu ga uvećati mnogo puta? …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi; zajam koji Allah vraća uvećan, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Who is it that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, so that He may give it increase manifold?” — ar-Rāġib cites these words; a loan Allah repays with increase, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: If ye lend unto Allah a goodly loan, He will double it for you and will forgive you, for Allah is Responsive, Clement,

explanation.bs: „Ako Allahu pozajmite lijepim zajmom, On će vam ga udvostručiti i oprostiti vam …“ – zajam vraćen uvećan i s oprostom, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “If ye lend unto Allah a goodly loan, He will double it for you and will forgive you” — the loan repaid with increase and forgiveness, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: They indeed are losers who deny their meeting with Allah until, when the Hour cometh on them suddenly, they cry: Alas for us, that we neglected it! They bear upon their backs their burdens. Ah, evil is that which they bear!

explanation.bs: „… kad im iznenada dođe Čas, reći će: ‚Teško nama zbog onoga što smo u tome zanemarili!‘“ – kajanje za propuštenim.
explanation.en: “When the Hour cometh on them suddenly, they cry: Alas for us, that we neglected it!” — regret for what was missed.

quranTranslation.text: So, When they despaired of (moving) him, they conferred together apart. The eldest of them said: Know ye not how your father took an undertaking from you in Allah's name and how ye failed in the case of Joseph aforetime? Therefore I shall not go forth from the land until my father giveth leave or Allah judgeth for me. He is the Best of Judges.

explanation.bs: Najstariji brat podsjeća: „… a i prije toga ste zakazali u pogledu Jusufa“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: The eldest brother reminds them “how ye failed in the case of Joseph aforetime” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And their Lord hath heard them (and He saith): Lo! I suffer not the work of any worker, male or female, to be lost. Ye proceed one from another. So those who fled and were driven forth from their homes and suffered damage for My cause, and fought and were slain, verily I shall remit their evil deeds from them and verily I shall bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow - A reward from Allah. And with Allah is the fairest of rewards.

explanation.bs: „Neću Ja pustiti da se izgubi djelo ikoga od vas ko radi – muškog ili ženskog spola …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; obećanje, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “I suffer not the work of any worker, male or female, to be lost” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; a promise, as befits Him.

gloss.en: to let go to waste, to let be lost

quranTranslation.text: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.

explanation.bs: „Zatim su ih naslijedili potomci koji su upropastili namaz i povodili se za strastima …“ – jedino mjesto gdje ljudi upropaštavaju.
explanation.en: “Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts” — the one place where people let something go to waste.

gloss.en: to let go to waste, to let be lost
